candidate.answerReason: Eleven hours is 660 minutes, and adding five minutes gives 665 minutes.

methods.label: Convert hours to minutes
methods.explanation:
Each hour contains \(60\) minutes, so \(11\) hours contains \(11\cdot60=660\) minutes. Adding the remaining \(5\) minutes gives
\[
660+5=\boxed{665\text{ minutes}}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\text{C}\).
